NO upright front-facing body, NO visible chest/belly, NO side profile, NO isometric view, NO face looking at viewer. All limbs extend along the floor plane. Use simple broad desaturated GRAY-PINK FLESH shapes, dark muted rose joint gaps and a few ivory claw tips; 2-3 flat tones, restrained dark outline, only a FEW big segmented/ribbed folds where anatomy requires them. No microtexture, veins, glossy polish, tiny details. No central eye symbol. Complete connected limbs and body; modest asymmetric running pose. Actual transparent background, no text, watermark, floor, glow, cast shadow, grid or frame. ANATOMY: Thick curved segmented worm-like torso with a broad blunt tubular head at the front, NO arms, exactly TWO short strong running legs attached at rear hips. Body is about three times wider than either leg. The dorsal head is a plain rounded fleshy cap, NOT a visible circular mouth looking at the camera. About five large soft segment folds, blunt rear without tail.
